name: @zyropay/mcp
description: Remote MCP server with OAuth on Cloudflare Workers. Never signs; calls the API's internal endpoints. Owner: MCP.

scripts.deploy: echo "Deploy with an environment: deploy:staging or deploy:production (docs/DEPLOY.md)" && exit 1
